swsh12pt5.notes: Rates from Card Codex per-pack table (community-compiled; method not published), p=1/N. Rare-slot default 'Rare' absorbs the remainder. Reverse-slot default draws uniformly from main-set C/U/R/Rare Holo, which matches Card Codex's reverse C/U/R/RH split (card-count proportional). API rarity 'Rare Ultra' lumps full-art V/VMAX, alt arts and full-art trainers together, so alt arts are not separated. Basic Energy is not in the inventory and is omitted. Radiant Rares are placed in the 5th Common slot (slot index 4) as an independent hit, so a pack can have TG + Radiant + rare-slot hit (some sources say radiants take the reverse slot; we follow the common-replacement reading). Galarian Gallery total is about 34.9% per pack (1 in 2.9), consistent with the commonly cited 1 in 3 to 4. GG 'Rare Holo' cards use API rarity 'Trainer Gallery Rare Holo'. Main-set Rare Secret has 1 card (rare slot only). v2: rebuilt at real English size: 10 game cards (5C/3U/1 reverse/1 rare) + 1 Basic Energy (energy omitted). Same per-pack rates as the 6-slot version.

ex1.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 4 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare (always), 1 reverse holo (any card, basic energy included), 1 premium slot (ex ~1 in 6, holo rare ~1 in 6, basic energy ~1 in 3, otherwise a common).

Holo+ex share the premium slot; the rare slot is always a non-holo Rare. Some early print runs reportedly had fewer holos (2-3/box) - not modeled.

ecard3.structure: Real English pack: 9 cards = 5 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 reverse-holo slot (any main-set card), 1 rare slot (non-holo rare, H-numbered holo rare ~1 in 3.4 packs, or Crystal Pokémon secret rare 145-150 ~1 in 18). No basic energy in the set.
ecard3.notes: There are no official odds; the H-holo (~1/3.4) and Crystal (~1/18) rates are community estimates.
